&b✆ &2Junker Joel &fhas been added to your Abiphone's contacts! }} |} == Tips == *The best upgrade order for early game gear is generally the {{Item|Challenging Rod}}, followed by the equipment pieces of {{Item|Backwater Armor}}, and finally the armor itself. **{{Item|Salmon Armor}} provides better survivability, although {{Item|Backwater Armor}} provides higher {{Stat|scc}} and {{Stat|treasure chance}} for cheaper, along with increased damage against [[Sea Creatures]]. *Before obtaining a {{Item|Treasure Hook}}, equipping 2 pieces of {{Item|Bronze Hunter Armor}} or better will achieve a similar effect. == Trivia == {{Sectionstub}} * It cost {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=1024}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=124}}, and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=12}}, along with {{Item|Bayou Water Orb|amount=1}} and {{Coins|10000}} to buy each items, with the exception of the {{Item|Treasure Bait}}. ** The {{Item|Hermit Crab Pet}} will cost an additional {{Item|Rusty Coin|amount=20}}, {{Item|Busted Belt Buckle|amount=8}} and {{Item|Old Leather Boot|amount=1}} to upgrade to {{Rarity|l|nolink=t}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Mar 12|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2026/Mar 23|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} |beta= {{History|2025/Mar 18|[[File:Junker Joel.png|26px]] Added '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|2025/Mar 19|Added {{Item|Treasure Hook}} to '''Junker Joel'''.}} {{History|0.24.3|Added Abiphone Contact.}} {{History|0.27.1|Removed {{Item|Travel Scroll to the Bayou}} from '''Junker Joel'''.|Reduced the {{Item|Rusty Coin}} cost of {{Item|Challenging Rod}} from {{Green|16}} to {{Green|8}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
